name: Tedee GO (EU)

radios.note: Bluetooth to the phone or Tedee Bridge; Thread for Matter after the firmware update.

matter.note: Tedee says the free firmware update (2.1.3493 or newer) has shipped and that the GO and GO2 support Matter 1.4.2. The CSA directory's Tedee entries include a separate certificate for the Tedee GO (CSA260DNMAT49899-24), shown alongside the GO2 listing cited here.

apple_home.note: Needs a Thread border router. Older Tedee pages say GO has no Apple Home support; they predate the Matter update.

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router. Tedee also offers a cloud route that needs the Tedee Bridge.

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router. Tedee also offers a cloud route that needs the Tedee Bridge.

home_assistant.note: The official Tedee integration lists the GO and talks to the Tedee Bridge over its local HTTP API, so it needs the bridge. Without a bridge, Home Assistant can add the GO through Matter over Thread with fewer features.

hubRequired.note: With Matter, no Tedee bridge is needed, only a Thread border router. The optional Tedee Bridge adds remote access and the cloud routes for Alexa and Google Home.

localControl.note: Tedee lists Matter over Thread as a local integration that does not use Tedee's cloud.

lockFit.note: Mounts on the inside, over a Euro-profile cylinder with an emergency (double-clutch) feature, and keeps your keys.

keypad.note: No keypad on the lock; Keypad PRO is a separate accessory and cannot be added directly through Matter.

power.note: Tedee states up to 6-8 months of battery life.

summary: Tedee GO is a small retrofit lock for Euro-profile cylinders. A firmware update added Matter over Thread, which Tedee lists for Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings. The optional Tedee Bridge adds remote access and Home Assistant control through the official integration. Three CR123A batteries power it.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router and firmware 2.1.3493 or newer.
Matter supports at most 20 PIN codes, and Keypad PRO and Door Sensor cannot be added through Matter.
Older Tedee pages still say GO does not work with Apple Home; they predate the Matter update.

sources.title: Tedee GO2 now works with Matter. Your Tedee GO does, too!
